name: Technitium DNS
author: Netlens
description: Registers your devices in Technitium DNS Server: an A record and a reverse (PTR) record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Works with a primary and secondary server and with a Technitium cluster. It only writes records it created itself (marked with a comment) and never changes or removes records made by anything else, such as Windows machines that register themselves.

config.label: Servers
config.help: The address of the web interface of every Technitium server, separated by commas (http://host:5380 or https://host:53443). List the primary and the secondary, or all cluster nodes; Netlens finds out where it can write.

config.label: API token(s)
config.help: A token for each server, in the same order and separated by commas, or one token for all. Create a separate user on each server with View and Modify permission on your zone and its reverse zones (no Delete permission needed) and make a token for it (Administration → Sessions → Create token).

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Only relevant for https addresses. Turn it off for a server with a self-signed certificate.
